text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I was waiting! For the perfect moment to 
show my magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
After all, the 'sparkling heartbeat' that 
Beauty wants 
is definitely talking about magic!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna show everyone! 
I'll teach them that magic is real!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is this—what is she doing!? 
Fighting a lone battle, Sweep Tosho 
charges straight toward the obstacle bot!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She leaps right onto the incoming arm—and 
runs! She's running!! 
Dashing fearlessly right on top of the 
robot!! And then—!?!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Take this! Magical Girl Sweepy's grand 
magic—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Tremble and burst, Burst☆Impatiens!!!!

text_block_list.name: King & Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? ...Ngh. 
W-...what...?

text_block_list.name: Sky & Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eh... No way—!? 
Whaaaaaaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She's FLYING!?!?!? 
No way, no way! Sweep, that's 
amaaaazing!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: How do you like that?! This is magic!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Everyone says it's impossible! 
Everyone says you can't do it, but making 
it happen is what magic is all about!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait!! Did you see that!? Sky!! 
That girl is incredible!! She actually 
flew through the sky!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So that robot was made of balloons... 
But if she broke it, what happens to the 
audition results—?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And now, I will announce this audition's 
muses☆ 
First up is—King Halo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The radiance you attained by embracing 
your past weaknesses was truly brilliant! 
I'm certain so many people will be 
encouraged by you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much. From here on, I shall 
continue to demonstrate my distinct, 
top-class flair!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Verxina-chan, I received your resolve 
loud and clear! You're going to keep on 
fighting, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"This audition taught me that this path is 
far from over—it's merely a process 
leading to victory."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"And Sweep Tosho-chan... oh my gosh, you 
are simply out of this world!! Your magic 
has got my inspiration overflowing!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Heh-heh! You'd better be grateful! That 
was Sweepy's extra-special magic, after 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"King-chan, Verxina-chan, and Sweep-chan! 
You all did marvelously in overcoming such 
a grueling audition!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Every single one of you was truly, 
undeniably *beauty*!! All three of you 
passed with flying colors! You're this 
year's Muses—congratulaaaations!!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos & Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yaaaay!!! Congratulations, Big Sis!!!! 
Hehe... Good for you, King."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One month later—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh-heh, not bad at all! Makes me look 
like a grown-up witch♪"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...My, aren't you in a good mood? And 
here I thought you had no interest in 
Racewear."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Because this Racewear is special! It's 
proof that I cast super-awesome magic 
that's just as good as Grandma's!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's proof that I've taken another step 
toward becoming a full-fledged witch—♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"—Oh my, are you two still hanging around 
here? Verxina-chan already headed off to 
the entrance ages ago, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be such a waste to keep Beauty 
Anshizawa's magnificent Racewear tucked 
away in secret!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't you have a 'certain someone' you 
wanted to show it off to? Come now, the 
grand unveiling is finally upon us—"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Hold your heads high and show off that 
sheer beauty for the whole world to 
seeee!!"
